name: Campingplatz Kesselberg
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Kesselberg is located directly on Lake Kochelsee, framed by the impressive scenery of the Alps. The surroundings invite varied outdoor activities such as hiking, cycling, and watersports. The park offers modern sanitary amenities and generous pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. Its tranquil, nature-orientated atmosphere provides a rejuvenating holiday for families and sailors making the most of the lake.
